description: List the reader's folder tree, which is also the set of categories driftnet sorts new links into. Call it before driftnet_move_items, driftnet_create_folder, driftnet_update_folder, driftnet_delete_folder or a folder-filtered driftnet_search_items to get valid ids; ids stay the same when a folder is renamed. Skip it when you already listed the folders in this session and nothing changed. Takes no parameters and returns the whole tree as a flat list: follow parent to rebuild the nesting (null means top level). items counts only the cards directly inside, not those in sub-folders; uses shows where the reader files most often, a good tiebreaker when two folders fit.
name: driftnet_list_folders
title: List folders
